alt: Both sides of a worn silver German coin from the Thirty Years War era, with a coat of arms on one side and an imperial eagle on the other.
note: Period debased coin (Brunswick-Wolfenbuettel, Friedrich Ulrich), public domain. cand-3 broadsheet carries antisemitic imagery and text and was rejected; cand-1 is an unrelated Danish news sheet. Wide image: crop to the eagle side.
